name: Futaba Maki
source: [url=/c56258]Chisa's[/url] older sister and [url=/c48319]Kazuya's[/url] first aunt, as well as his homeroom teacher. She is quite strict and doesn't tolerate students who slack off or disobey her, and is often compared to a demon. Despite her harsh punishments and very strict nature, she is quite lazy when at home, always lounging around in her underwear and barely does any kind of household chores.
